issues.what: Berenguera retells the ferryman's salting as a years-old event with a different vow and a wife, contradicting ch1's Peyre, which Azalais witnessed
issues.quote: I saw a ferryman salt once... Years ago, when I was new to the seal.

issues.what: Flashback invents a rainy first chess night, the yellow draft found in Guilhem's rooms and a margin note that never existed
issues.quote: when she found the yellow draft in Guilhem's rooms

issues.what: Article order contradicts ch3 (marriage was Article the first; tithe article contradicts the open road)
issues.quote: Article Three on the white tithe at the causeway gates

issues.what: Yellow draft called Guilhem's fair hand; ch4 established its road clause was a Montclar scribe's and the fair copy was the blue draft
issues.quote: It was Guilhem's fair hand, each letter upright and modest

issues.what: Supper scene re-runs ch4's archive confession as if new: the forty-thousand argument, the one-night request and the exact line 'I hoped you might once be less excellent'
issues.quote: I hoped you might once be less excellent.

issues.what: Azalais re-asks the promise-to-the-dead question as if for the first time (asked ch2, again ch7, again in ch8 flashback)
issues.quote: As a notary. Tell me true. If I promised my mother

issues.what: Undoes ch6's resolution (mother's real words were 'make the peace hold') and swaps in new deathbed words
issues.quote: now I think she meant make the peace hold?

issues.what: Oath rule drift: 'only the seal binds' contradicts ch1's spoken-and-heard rule; ch7/ch8 repeat the confusion
issues.quote: Only the seal binds, and only after reading aloud.

issues.what: Clerk whitening on an initial is raised as a mystery and never explained
issues.quote: That I did not write. An initial is a courtesy.

issues.what: Spectacles he never unfolds described as having lived 'unfolded'; ch5 garbled 'took off his spectacles case'
issues.quote: where they had lived unfolded for twenty years

issues.what: Stumps 'bled through the bandage' contradicts the bloodless salting in the same chapter
issues.quote: your stumps bled through the bandage

issues.what: Guilhem cited as present before ch3 reveals his arrival as a surprise
issues.quote: Guilhem says you are being polite.

issues.what: Duplicate titles: ch1/ch2 'The Notary's Seal', ch4/ch7 'Article Seven'; ch5 'The Sealing Wax' and ch6 'The Upstairs Warning' fit poorly; ch7 'eve of the wedding' when it is the treaty sealing

fix: Ch7: replace the ferryman retelling with Peyre; drop the re-asked dead-promise question and keep ch6's resolution; explain the clerk's thumb as wavering on his indenture oath. Ch8: replace false flashback, fix article order and binding rule. Ch6: yellow draft is a Montclar hand with Guilhem's margin. Ch4/5: move the confession to ch5. Retitle ch2, 5, 6, 7.
praise: A genuinely original magic system with a cost that bites (the whitening little finger on the night she almost says it), and a finale where legal wordplay becomes a love declaration in 'present and possible verbs'.

issues.what: The king asks about the camel before Mahnaz has mentioned one (brief leaking into dialogue)
issues.quote: Her name was worth a camel?

issues.what: Tap code gives two taps three meanings (listen, lie, slow)
'When they were seven and nine' clashes with a nine-year age gap (15 and 24)
issues.quote: When they were seven and nine

issues.what: 'Six hundred and one' contradicts the title's six hundredth night
issues.quote: Six hundred and one is an ugly number to end on.

praise: Taut lamplit frame and a lovely stopping point: the die still spinning at the watchman's cry, and the king leaning his sword against the chair.
